metadata.title: ChatGPT Image 2 Pricing

benefits.title: Model Flash Sale
benefits.description: All base & enhanced models at 90% off (limited-time flash sale): Seedance 1.5 Pro 40 → 4 credits, Seedream 5.0 20 → 2 credits, Veo 3 100 → 10 credits; up to 60% off SOTA models per generation.

benefits.title: All Premium Models Unlocked
benefits.description: Use MiniMax H3, Seedance 2.0 and Veo 3.1 Premium from the Starter plan, plus every premium model like Seedance 2.0 Pro, Seedream and Nano Banana Pro.

benefits.title: Commercial License
benefits.description: Yearly plans include a commercial license — use your creations in commercial projects, watermark-free.

benefits.title: Price Locked for 12 Months
benefits.description: Yearly prices are locked for 12 months. No price increase on renewal, up to 50% off.

benefits.title: Unlimited Storage · Private
benefits.description: All plans include unlimited storage and private generations — your creations are visible only to you by default.

benefits.title: Cancel Anytime · Rollover
benefits.description: Cancel your subscription anytime. Unused credits roll over automatically — nothing goes to waste.

models.section_description: Credits per generation for each model, synced with the selected plan
models.not_included_label: Not included in the current plan

items.name: Wan 3.0
items.description: Shows 480p 5s price. Base rate: 480p 8 credits/s, 720p 14 credits/s, 1080p 27 credits/s. Reference-video mode bills input + output duration. Credits required on all plans.

items.name: Wan 3.0 Prime
items.description: Shows 480p 5s price. Base rate: 480p 10 credits/s, 720p 20 credits/s, 1080p 40 credits/s. Reference-video mode bills input + output duration. Credits required on all plans.

items.name: MiniMax H3
items.description: Shows 768P 5s price. Base rate: 768P 20 credits/s, 2K 30 credits/s. Credits required on all paid plans; monthly Pro 20% off, monthly Unlimited 50% off, up to 60% off on yearly. First 5 reference images free, then 5 credits each (no plan discounts).

items.name: Seedance 2.5
items.description: Shows 480p 4s price. Billed per second, up to 40% off for yearly users. Credits required on all plans.
